title: I Made a Browser Arcade Shooter Where You Blast Angry Durians
author: woba_games
selftext:
Hey everyone! I just released my first game, Bubbles & Durians, a 3D arcade shooter you can play in your browser.

There are three modes:

* **Standard**: a timed score attack
* **Blitz**: a shorter, faster timed run
* **Endless**: you play on lives and try to survive as long as possible

There's also an online leaderboard. Can you reach the top?

**Play here:** [wobagames.itch.io/bubblesanddurians](https://wobagames.itch.io/bubblesanddurians)

I'd love feedback on how it feels, especially aiming, difficulty, and anything that breaks. Thanks for playing!
